title: 第八章 别样感受
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
一段时间的沉淀后，众人的情绪都平复了许多。

    小侍女在前方引路。

    季南北则压低声线悄悄询问:

    “你平时和你师尊交流，都是怎样的状态?怎么称呼......”

    季南北必须弄清这些细枝末节。

    万一露出什么马脚，真的被怀疑上就麻烦了。

    季南北倒是相信系统能保障自己安全，但往后想来萧京溪这儿，肯定阻碍重重，平添不少麻烦。

    沿途走来，季南北见到了不少年轻弟子，大多穿着和小侍女一样的青色衣袍，偶尔能遇见几个蓝衣的，却始终没见到白衣身影。

    可见仙灵剑宗的亲传弟子确实稀少。

    这一路上，季南北发觉许多弟子在自己经过时都会驻足停步，似乎想上前问好，但最终都没敢开口。

    直到临近太玄殿前的一段石阶，才有人做出了不一样的举动。

    经过时，一名身着蓝衣的女弟子朝季南北躬身行礼，轻声说道:

    “萧师姐好!”

    萧京溪在仙灵剑宗内，人气确实极高。

    毕竟，一位容貌出众、修为超凡、性情又不倨傲的剑仙子，自然是许多人心中仰望的白月光。

    这位小师妹平日就对萧京溪仰慕非常。只是听说萧京溪素来清冷寡言，才一直不敢与自己憧憬的剑仙姐姐搭话。

    不过这次她刚好被门内长老唤到太玄殿交代事务，出来时恰巧瞧见了那位剑仙姐姐。

    距离很近。

    小师妹还是头一回离这位传说中的剑仙子如此之近。

    于是终于鼓起勇气，打了声招呼。

    招呼打完，小师妹整个人都怔住了。

    自己怎么这么大胆!

    是不是太冒失了?师姐平时那么清冷，应该不喜欢被人打扰吧。

    师姐会不会觉得我碍眼啊......

    种种念头涌上心头，却在这时

    “师妹好。”小师妹难以置信地抬起头，仿佛想确认这声音是否真的来自面前的剑仙师姐。

    结果一抬眼，便看见那位传闻中极其清冷的师姐，脸上正带着一抹浅浅的笑意。

    啊，我不行了!

    季南北其实并没在意，他只是礼貌性地回应了一下，随即径直往前走去。
content_en:
After a period of calm, everyone's emotions calmed down a lot.

    The little maid leads the way.

    Ji Nanbei lowered his voice and asked quietly:

    "How do you usually communicate with your master? How do you call it..."

    Ji Nanbei must figure out these details.

    If something is revealed, it will be really troublesome if you are really suspected.

    Ji Nanbei believed that the system could guarantee his safety, but if he wanted to come to Xiao Jingxi in the future, there would definitely be many obstacles and a lot of trouble.

    Along the way, Ji Nanbei saw many young disciples, most of whom wore the same cyan robes as the maids. Occasionally he met a few in blue, but never saw anyone in white.

    It can be seen that the direct disciples of the Immortal Sword Sect are indeed rare.

    Along the way, Ji Nanbei noticed that many disciples would stop when he passed by, as if they wanted to go up and say hello, but in the end they did not dare to speak.

    It wasn't until they approached a section of stone steps in front of Taixuan Hall that someone made a different move.

    As they passed by, a female disciple in blue bowed to Ji Nanbei and said softly:

    "Hello, Senior Sister Xiao!"

    Xiao Jingxi is indeed very popular in the Xianling Sword Sect.

    After all, a sword fairy with outstanding appearance, extraordinary cultivation, and not arrogant temperament is naturally the Bai Yueguang that many people look up to.

    This little junior sister always admires Xiao Jingxi very much. It's just that I heard that Xiao Jingxi has always been cold and taciturn, so she never dared to talk to the sword fairy sister that she admired.

    But this time she happened to be summoned to Taixuan Hall by the elders of the sect to explain matters, and when she came out, she happened to see the sword fairy sister.

    The distance is very close.

    This is the first time that the junior sister has been so close to the legendary sword fairy.

    So I finally plucked up the courage and said hello.

    After saying hello, the junior sister was completely stunned.

    Why are you so bold!

    Isn't that too rash? Senior sister is usually so cold and cool, she probably doesn't like to be disturbed.

    Will senior sister think I'm an eyesore...

    All kinds of thoughts came to my mind, but at this moment

    "Hello, junior sister." The little junior sister raised her head in disbelief, as if she wanted to confirm whether the voice really came from the sword fairy senior sister in front of her.

    As a result, when he looked up, he saw the senior sister who was rumored to be extremely cold and cold, with a faint smile on her face.

    Ah, I can't do it anymore!

    Ji Nanbei didn't actually care. He just responded politely and walked straight forward.
